examples.answer:
You submit expense claims in **SpendHub**. Claims must be submitted in SpendHub within 30 calendar days of the expense date. [IronStore_Expense_Reimbursement_Policy.pdf, p. 5]

Note: the Employee Handbook says business expenses must be submitted in **SpendFlow** within 30 days of the transaction, which conflicts with the Finance policy. Please confirm with Finance or Payroll which system is currently in use. [IronStore_Employee_Handbook.pdf, p. 4] [IronStore_Expense_Reimbursement_Policy.pdf, p. 5]

Confidence: High
